idea-plugin.name: Teek Markdown Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Renders VitePress Theme Teek custom markdown containers in the Markdown preview.

  • ::: video bilibili|tencent|youku|youtube|vimeo|xigua — video container, rendered as a card that opens in the browser
  • ::: note|tip|warning|danger|info|details — callout containers
  • ::: center and ::: right — alignment containers
  • ::: shareCard|imgCard|navCard — card containers, the YAML inside is parsed
  • ::: demo — component demo placeholder
  • TODO lists (- [ ] / - [x])
  • Image paths starting with / are resolved against the VitePress public directory

Videos cannot be embedded in the preview because of the editor's content security policy; they are shown as cards and open in the browser instead.

Open source under the MIT license. Author: handy.
